title: WorkflowConfig
description:
`Workflow`: one decision-model call, then LLM escalation for the fields
it's unsure about.

decision_model.description: A System One decision model, e.g. `ollama:nimble` or `typesafe:jev-latest`.

reply_model.description: Writes `suggested_reply` from the final triage. `None`: no reply.

sub_agent.description:
Use a tool-using sub-agent (instead of a single LLM call) for the
fields that need repo context: `area` and `duplicates`.

Thresholds.description: Confidence thresholds for accepting a decision-model answer.

accept.description: Answers at or above this confidence are accepted as they are.

per_field.description: Per-field overrides of `accept`, by `Triage` field name.
